verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item documents any opt-out or setting to prevent user data/conversations from being used for AI model training; nothing in docs, apps, or CLI references a training-data opt-out or privacy control. Community evidence instead raises concerns about Perplexity ignoring robots.txt/crawling restrictions, which is unrelated to user data training opt-out but does not help either. missing for 10: any documentation of a training opt-out setting, privacy policy citation, or user control over data usage for model training.
